Commentary.Commentary: All the bowlers apart from JP Duminy conceded more than 6 runs an over. Andile Phehlukwayo and Chris Morris picked up a couple of wickets each while Kagiso Rabada and Wayne Parnell picked up a wicket apiece. Imran Tahir had a rare off day at the office and would look to come back stronger next time around. Their batsmen have an uphill task in front of them but they do possess the firepower to chase this total down. Second innings coming up shortly!

Captain Eoin Morgan then led from the front, steering his team to a huge total by scoring a century. He first stitched a partnership with Ben Stokes and then a crucial one with Moeen Ali towards the end. Ali's knock was an entertaining one which helped them add 102 runs in the last 10 overs, which would be hurting the Proteas a lot.

Superb finish from the Englishmen see them post the highest-ever total in ODIs at this ground. After losing Jason Roy early, Alex Hales and Joe Root steadied the ship for England with a 98-run stand. The former scored his 8th half century while the latter failed to capitalize on his start.
SIX! Ali finishes off in style! On a length and on the pads, Ali whips it over long leg and the ball keeps on sailing. Clears the fence with ease. ENGLAND FINISH WITH 339/6!
Keeps it very full and around off, Woakes jams it through mid off for a run.

Run out chance missed! Woakes drills this fullish delivery to Faf du Plessis at extra cover and takes off. Faf aims at the bowler's end but misses. There is no one backing up and the batsmen steal an extra run. Had Faf hit, Woakes was a goner.
Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, Ali pulls it to short fine leg for a single.
Fullish and on the pads, Ali picks it up over backward square leg for two runs.
Fullish delivery tailing in nicely, Chris Woakes gives himself room and carves it to backward point. A run taken.
Very full on off, Woakes guides it towards point for a run.
Full toss around the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a run.
Rabada hurls in a fine yorker well outside off, Ali fails to carve it away.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shortish delivery on leg stump, sits up nicely for Ali. He pulls it with authority over backward square leg to find the fence.
Brilliant yorker on middle, Woakes backs away and keeps it out on the off side for a single.
Well bowled! Back of a length ball on off, zips through the pitch. Woakes look to play it with an angled bat but gets beaten.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Fuller length ball outside off, Ali swings wildly across the line but gets an outside edge through third man for a boundary.
Full and on off, Ali jams it back to the bowler.
Chris Woakes walks out to bat.

OUT! A special knock from Morgan comes to an end! He has put his side in a commanding position. Fuller length ball on off, Morgan clears his front leg and looks to go over covers. His head is not in a good position while playing it and so he ends up miscuing it towards wide long off. JP Duminy runs in and keeps his calm to pouch it safely.
Ali makes room and Morris follows him with a fullish delivery. Ali turns it from the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Bowls a low full toss wide outside off, Ali is not able to reach it.
Keeps it full and on off, Morgan backs away and pushes it to covers for a run.
Fullish delivery around off, pushed to mid off for a single.
Chris Morris is back on.
FOUR! Sloppy work from Morris! Full toss on middle, Morgan whips it towards mid-wicket. Morris makes a mess of it and concedes a boundary. 13 from that over.
11th ODI ton for the English skipper, Eoin Morgan!
SIX! Brilliant knock from the English skipper! Dug in short on leg stump, Morgan pulls it over fine leg for a huge maximum. A very well-deserved century and he is absolutely pumped up.
Morgan shuffles across and Rabada keeps it fullish outside off, cut to backward point.
Fuller length ball slanting across Moeen. He has a wild swing at it but gets an outside edge to third man. A run taken.
Wide! Bowls it very full but well outside off, Ali fails to reach to it. 300 up for England!
Well-directed bouncer in line of the stumps, Ali goes for the pull but gets beaten.
Very full delivery outside off, Morgan can only carve it through point for a run.
Kagiso Rabada comes on to bowl now!
Short of a length delivery outside off, Ali looks to force it over covers but misses.
100-run stand between Morgan and Ali and that too just in 73 balls. Great stand, this!
Slower bouncer sliding down leg, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
Ali backs away and Phehlukwayo follows him with a full toss. He can only hit it down to long off for a run.
Bowls a low full toss on off, Ali mistimes his loft to deep cover for a single.
Phehlukwayo comes around the wicket and bowls a fullish delivery on middle, played down through mid on for a run.

SIX! England are gaining a lot of momentum here! Back of a length delivery on leg stump, Morgan uses his feet and pulls it over deep mid-wicket. Generates good power on that and gets the desired result!
Full toss wide outside off, Ali reaches to it and carves it to deep point for two runs. 22 runs from that over, a great one for the home side.
5th ODI fifty for Moeen Ali!

SIX! Reaches his fifty in style! Tossed up on middle and leg, Ali uses his feet and lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a huge maximum. It has been a top knock from him and he is taking England towards a big total.
SIX! Straight as an arrow! Loopy ball on middle, Ali dances down the track and clubs it over the bowler's head. Has timed that to perfection and the ball clears the fence with ease.
Quicker and flatter delivery on off, Morgan plays a short arm jab to long on for a run.
Floated outside off, Ali lifts it over covers for an easy single.
SIX! Tossed up outside off, Ali extends his arms and tonks it over mid off. Hasn't got it from the middle of the bat but still has enough on it to clear the man in the deep.
Low full toss outside off, Morgan carves it straight to the point fielder. Failed to capitalize on it.
Another well-executed slower bouncer outside off, Moeen drags it to mid-wicket for a single.
Morgan uses his feet and strokes it to deep cover for a run.
On a good length on middle, Ali clears his front leg and has a wild heave at it. Mistimes it past the bowler for a single.
Slower short delivery on middle and leg, Morgan pulls it through backward square leg for a run.
Short of a length outside off, Morgan goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper.
Tossed up outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
Full around off, Ali jams it past the bowler and towards long off for a run.
FOUR! Sloppy work from de Villiers! Ali steps down the track and drives it on the full. AB at extra cover makes a mess of it and allows the ball to go through to the fence.
Slow through the air outside off, played with an open face to point.
Fullish on middle and leg, Eoin works it through wide mid on for a single.
Very full outside off, Morgan jams it out down the track.
Imran Tahir is back on.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, Morgan goes for the pull but gets an inside edge past his leg stump and towards short fine leg. A single taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
In the air... but safe! On a length on off, Ali punches it on the up. Parnell at extra cover, dives to his right but the ball falls short of him. A run taken.
Another short delivery down the leg side, Ali looks to pull but gets off the glove towards fine leg. Morris runs to his left and keeps it down to two.
Short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Morgan looks to pull it hard but misses to get rapped on the thigh pad. The ball sails into the gloves of the keeper.
Short delivery on leg stump, pulled to fine leg for a single. 250 comes up for England and it is met with a loud cheer from the crowd.
50-run stand comes up between Morgan and Ali!
FOUR! Banged in short down the leg side, Ali pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary. 12 runs off the over. So, England are getting a move on now!
Wide! Down the leg side, Ali still goes after it but misses. A wide is signalled.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! Smoked it! A touch behind length around leg, Ali dances down and pulls it over mid-wicket for half a dozen. Moeen Ali showing some intent now.
Back of a length delivery, punched to mid off.
Length delivery on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Morgan works it on the leg side for a single.
Wayne Parnell to start the proceedings of this Powerplay.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled! Now, AB de Villiers can have 5 players outside the circle.
Length delivery, slanting away, Morgan punches it with the angle to deep covers for a single. 11 runs off the over!
SIX! Freebie! Such a poor Free Hit delivery! Slower short delivery. Morgan waits and waits for it and then pulls it into the mid-wicket stands for a biggie. This literally was a gift!
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! Fuller length delivery, defended on the off side. Hang on, a no ball has been called as there were 5 men outside the circle.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Pitched on a length around leg, Morgan looks to pull but misses. The ball lobs off the thigh pad and falls safely on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Long on in place now.
Short outside leg, Ali pulls it on its way down to fine leg for a single.
On a length around leg, Ali looks to play across the line but is beaten.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes back into the attack.

Run out chance! Short delivery, angling away, Ali gets on his toes and looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the boots. The ball rolls on the off side and the batsmen run through for a single. Duminy at point is quick to get to the ball and hurls a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Ali was a goner!
Banged in short, Ali ducks underneath and lets it sail through.
Full outside off, angling away. Ali goes for a flashy drive but misses it completely.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Morgan cuts it past point for a single.
On a length around middle and leg, Ali plays with soft hands wide of mid on for a single.
Fuller length delivery, slanting away, Morgan prods forward and pushes it through covers for a single.
Flatter delivery, Morgan goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter delivery, Morgan goes back and cuts it past point for a brace.
Fired in full around off, Ali digs it out on the off side for a single.
Morgan prods forward and pushes the ball on the off side by bringing bat and pad close. A single is taken.
FOUR! Cut away! Off spinner but slightly shorter in length. Morgan goes back and cuts it through the gap between point and short third man for a boundary.

Banged in short, Morgan jumps, leans back to leave but it's too close to his body. He then puts bat on it, gets an outside edge and the ball runs down to third man for a single. Good delivery to end the over!
Length delivery, angling away, Ali presses forward and pushes with the angle in the cover-point region. Duminy there half stops it and the batsmen run through for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Moeen looks to flick it but misses. A wide is signalled.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length delivery around leg, Morgan gets on his toes to tuck but gets an inside edge onto the body and on the leg side. A single is taken.

Angling away from Morgan, he prods ahead and pushes with the angle on the off side. The fielder at extra cover, hares to his left but fails to make a clean stop. However, the long off fielder is quick to back up and so no runs conceded.
Full and straight on the stumps, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up full outside off, Ali drives it through covers for a single.
Shortish off spinner around off, Ali looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards covers.
Tossed up outside off, milked down to long off for a single.
Morgan prods ahead and defends the off spinner on the off side.
FOUR! Poor line, punished! Duminy bowls it down the leg side, Morgan kneels down and sweeps it through fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller on the stumps, driven straight back. Duminy dives to his left and makes a good stop.
JP Duminy is back on.
Banged in short, Ali ducks and leaves it.

FOUR! Just past the fielder! Shortish delivery, angling away, Ali pushes it uppishly through point. Duminy there, leaps to his right but fails to get his hands to the ball. The ball runs to the fence behind. Ali has to be more careful. They have just lost Buttler.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Ali looks to pull it on the leg side but the ball goes from under his bat to the keeper.
On a length and angling away, punched to covers.
Pitched outside off, left alone.
Moeen Ali strides out to bat.

OUT! Excellent captaincy from de Villiers! Angling down leg, Buttler looks to flick it away but finds Miller at short fine leg, who gets low and takes it with a reverse cup. Buttler is disappointed and why won't he be? He just had to get it a few inches to either side of the man there but hit it straight to him. This is a big blow as Buttler can be very dangerous at the fag end of the innings.
Chris Morris is into the attack now.
Fullish delivery, eased to long off for a run.
FOUR! Effortless! Full toss on middle, Buttler clips it with pure timing through mid-wicket and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Tossed up on off, Buttler goes for the fancy reverse sweep and connects decently. Gets it past the sliding short third man fielder for two runs.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

In the air... but safe! Shortish delivery on middle, Morgan is early into his pull shot and top edges it down the ground. Miller comes running in from long on but the ball falls short of him. A run taken.
A touch short outside off, punched to covers.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
On a length outside off, left alone.
Jos Buttler is the new man in. A slip and a leg gully in place for him.

OUT! Rabada strikes! Clever bowling this from him. After going full and wide in all his previous deliveries, he goes a touch short and on middle. Stokes pulls it flat in front of square on the leg side. Miller in the deep, runs to his right, judges the ball to perfection and pouches it with a reverse cup. The dangerous Stokes depart and this ends the 68-run stand.
Once again it's full outside off, Morgan drives it through cover-point for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, punched to covers.
Wide! Angling away from Morgan. He goes after it with a wild slash but misses. Wide is signalled!
Full wide outside off, Stokes drives it through cover-point for a single.
Wide! Rabada looks to angle it away from Stokes but gets his line wrong. It's too wide and the umpire spreads his arms to signal a wide.
Time for Drinks.
Leg break on leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter through the air again around off, defended on the off side.

Edged but safe! Flatter delivery, sliding away, Morgan looks to punch it away but gets an outside edge. The ball runs fine past the keeper. Phehlukwayo at short third man, runs to his right and puts in a dive to make a fantastic stop. A single is taken.
Googly, full on leg. Stokes reads it and drives it with the turn through mid off for a single.
Full outside off, Morgan wrists it through wide mid on for a single.
Loopy ball around off, defended down the wicket.
Morgan waits for the ball to come close to him and then glides it to third man for a single.
Well-directed bouncer! Rabada bangs it short, angling away. Morgan leans backwards to leave it alone.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, defended on the leg side.
Pitched around leg, flicked to deep mid-wicket. Morgan wants a second but Stokes is satisfied with a single.

SIX! That's a clean hit! Length delivery on middle and leg, Stokes charges down, gives himself room and smokes it over long on for a biggie. This is some shot from Ben. They have got the platform now and are also getting a move on.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, defended from within the crease on the off side.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack now.
33rd ODI fifty for Eoin Morgan! The 50-run stand between Morgan and Stokes also comes up.

FOUR! Tahir comes back to over the wicket and drags his length back. Bowls a flatter delivery around off, Morgan goes deep in his crease and cuts it through covers. It has been hit well and the ball rolls away to the fence. A well-deserved fifty for the English skipper and he has brought it up in quick time.
FOUR! Shot! Tahir comes around the wicket and bowls a googly outside off, Morgan uses his wrists and lifts it over covers for a boundary.
Stays back to the shorter length delivery and eases it through mid off for a run.
Fullish around off, Morgan milks it to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, stroked past the cover fielder for a run.
Floated on off, Morgan eases it to the left side of Tahir. He tries desperately to stop it but fails to stop the single.
Tossed up delivery, eased through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Tossed up outside off, Morgan goes inside out and does so beautifully. Plays it in the gap in the deep cover region for a boundary.
Fullish outside off, Morgan drives it crisply but finds AB at extra cover.
That one almost zipped through! Quicker delivery on off, Stokes looks to cut it but the length is a bit fullish. Ends up chopping it through point for a run.
A touch short around off, punched through covers for a single.
Full toss on middle, Stokes strokes it down the track. Duminy runs to his left and slides but fails to stop it. A single taken.
Full on middle and leg, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single. Tidy over from Tahir.
Quicker one on middle, turned to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Googly on a fullish length outside off, played with an open face to point.
Camps back to this one and works it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tahir drags his length back a bit and bowls it on middle and leg, punched towards wide mid on for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Morgan nudges it towards front of square on the leg side. Stokes wants the single but is rightly sent back.
Imran Tahir is back on.
Flatter delivery on middle and off, Morgan camps back and cuts it towards point.
Strides forward to the loopy delivery and defends it nicely.
Quicker delivery coming in with the arm. Punched to long off for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, cut past point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around off, drilled to long off for a single.
Andile comes around the wicket and bowls it around off, Morgan looks to dab it but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper.

SIX! On a fuller length around off, Morgan looks to go inside out but ends up slicing it over wide long off. The umpires check whether it is a boundary or a maximum. The replays show that it landed on the boundary cushions.
Stokes comes down the track to this one and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and angling across, cut past point for a single.
FOUR! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Morgan pulls it stylishly over square leg for a boundary.

Not out! Fuller length delivery around the leg stump, Stokes looks to clip it through mid-wicket but seems to have missed it. The ball rolls towards third man and the batsmen take a run. However, Phehlukwayo convinces his skipper that it hit the pad before the bat. De Villiers goes for the only review. The replays show that it has probably pitched outside leg. There is also an inside edge there. Review wasted!
An appeal for lbw against Stokes is turned down. The umpire has signaled it as run and so South Africa have opted to use their review!
Ben helps this one to the leg side for a run.
Morgan eases this one through mid on for a single.
Vicious turn this time! Flatter delivery on off, Morgan shapes for the cut but is beaten all ends up.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Flatter delivery on middle, pushed off the back foot towards mid on. Duminy and du Plessis run after it. There is no calling who will stop the ball and the ball lobs up from the boot of du Plessis and into the hands of Duminy.
Sliding into the pads, Stokes looks to defend tentatively off his front foot but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Eoin stays back to the length delivery in line of the stumps and defends it solidly.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Stokes mistimes his pull through mid-wicket for a run.
This time it is a bit wider outside off, Stokes lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off, Morgan cuts it behind point for a run.
Once again the line is leg sidish and Ben helps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Straying on the pads, nudged through square leg for a run.
Slow through the air on off, Morgan drives it a bit uppishly through mid off for a run.
Wide! Pushed quicker through the air but down the leg side, Morgan look to clip but misses.
Fullish on middle, Ben eases it down towards long on for a single.
Another one that is sliding into the pads and this time Stokes misses his tuck to get rapped on the pads.
Sliding into the pads, Stokes looks to defend it off his front foot but is hit on the pads.
Low full toss on off, Eoin eases it through mid off for a single.
A touch short around off, punched with the spin to covers.
Seeing two southpaws out in the middle, AB de Villiers has brought his off spinner, JP Duminy into the attack now.
Good bouncer! Dug in short and slanting across Stokes. He sways away from the line to evade it. Great comeback from Phehlukwayo after conceding a maximum in the first ball of the over!
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it solidly to mid on.
Ben Stokes is the new man in.

OUT! Root departs in an attempt to up the ante! And it is Phehlukwayo who again does the trick! Dug in short just outside off and it shoots off the pitch. Root rises on his toes and looks to pull it away. He is not in control as he top edges his shot and the ball spoons towards Amla at mid-wicket, who moves to his right and takes a simple catch. A rare failure from Root.
Leg bye! On a length around the pads, Morgan misses his tuck and the ball strikes his pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Fine leg comes up. Square leg goes back.
Brilliant stop, Dumniny! Back of a length outside off, Morgan crouches and cuts it hard to Duminy at point. He dives to his left and makes a sharp stop.

SIX! What a shot! On a good length on middle and leg, Morgan shimmies down the track and tonks it over wide long on for a maximum. He was very confident with the use of his feet and absolutely nailed it.
Short delivery outside off, Morgan rises on his toes and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, stays a bit low. Root is surprised a bit but manages to pull it down to fine leg. A run taken.
On a length outside off, Root taps it towards point and looks for a run. Duminy attacks the ball and denies the single.
Morgan charges down the track and Parnell bowls it wide outside off. The English skipper carves it to deep point for a run.
Back of a length delivery angling in from outside off, Root moves across, walks down the track and pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Angles in a length ball from around the wicket to Root. He camps back and pushes it to the off side.
Short and angling in, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Root clips the ball straight to mid-wicket.

Cutter on middle, Morgan gets across and flicks it past diving de Villiers at mid on. Tahir from deep mid-wicket covers good ground to his right and pulls the ball back in. De Villiers then gets to the ball and throws it back. Three runs are taken.
On middle and leg, Morgan plays it across the line to mid on.
Fuller length delivery, slanting across, pushed on the up to mid off.

Morgan dances down by making some room. Phehlukwayo bowls it back of a length outside leg. The English skipper looks to tuck it away but misses. He wants a wide but the umpire doesn't signal it. The ball might have clipped something on it's way.
Parnell comes from around the wicket and angles it into Root, who clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Edged but safe! Fuller length delivery outside off, Morgan looks to cover drive it on the up but ends up outside edging it towards third man for a single.
On a length and slanting away. Root waits for the ball to come close to him and then glides it towards third man for a single.
Angling into the southpaw, Morgan wrists it wide of de Villiers at mid on for a single.
Fuller length outside off, Morgan walks ahead a touch and drives it straight to covers.
Parnell is having a discussion with his skipper. The third man fielder has been moved a bit squarer.
Full and straight on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around middle and off, Eoin pushes it off the front foot towards mid off.
Angling away from Morgan, punched with the angle towards cover.
Pitched on a good length on middle and off, shaping in a bit, Morgan gets across and defends it on the leg side.
Pitched outside off, Root guides it towards third man for a single.
Short around leg, Morgan stays tall and tucks it on the leg side for a single. Off the mark straightaway!
Eoin Morgan walks out to bat. A slip in place for the English skipper.

OUT! Wicket off the first ball for Phehlukwayo! Just what his skipper wanted from him! Back of a length wide outside off. It's there to be hit and Hales goes after the width. He flashes his bat at it but gets an outside edge through to de Kock, who doesn't make any mistake. Hales cannot believe that he missed out on that. A much-needed wicket for the Proteas. End of a 98-run stand!
Andile Phehlukwayo is introduced into the attack!
Slower one on a length on middle, Hales gets across, waits for the ball to come towards him and then clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Short and angling away, Root gets on his toes and glides it towards third man for a single. 100 up for England!
Slower one on the pads, Hales wrists it behind square on the leg side for a single.
The umpires are having a look at the ball. There is a bit of damage done to it and it is being replaced by a different one.

SIX! Boom! That has come out of nowhere! Length delivery on middle and leg, Hales comes down the wicket, gives himself some room as well and then tonks it over wide long on for a maximum. He is now taking the attack to the opposition.
Good length delivery on middle, played on the up to mid on.
On the pads, Hales tickles it fine down the leg side. Tahir from fine leg, runs to his right and makes a good sliding stop. A brace is taken!
Wayne Parnell is back on.

Time for Drinks. England are cruising at the moment. Hales is looking really confident and is batting well. Root is also rotating the strike nicely. The Proteas need to break this threatening partnership to come back into the contest.
Banged in short, Hales pulls it handsomely and the ball goes on the bounce to the deep mid-wicket fielder. A single is taken.
On a length outside off, pushed to covers.
Short delivery, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Angling into the batsman, tucked to mid-wicket.
Full outside off, driven to Duminy at point.
8th ODI fifty for Alex Hales.

Good fielding, Duminy! A touch behind length outside off. Hales looks to latch on the width on offer as he cuts it away. But, Duminy at point, dives to his right to half-stop the ball. He then goes to the ball and hurls a throw at the non-striker's end but misses. A single is completed and so is Hales' half century.
Tossed up around off, driven to extra cover.
Root leans ahead and flicks the ball in the gap at mid-wicket. Gets a couple. He is ticking along nicely!
Leg spinner around off, JR goes back and punches it towards extra cover.
Low full toss on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg for a single.
Full on middle, Root looks to push it off the front foot but gets it off the inner half in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Served outside leg, straightening a touch. Alex goes back and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length outside off, Hales punches it comfortably through covers for a single.
Pitched on a length, Hales chops it towards the keeper. A dot after 7 balls!
FOUR! Streaky runs! Length delivery outside off, Hales looks to cut it but gets an outside edge. The ball runs fine past de Kock and beats the third man fielder as well to find the fence.
Short and angling down leg, pulled on its way to deep backward square leg for a single.
Full and straight on the stumps, flicked with ease to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around off, nipping in a touch, Root goes back and tucks it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Full on middle and leg, clipped in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Leg break on the shorter length around middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Full toss on the stumps, Joe kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single. He should have put that away!
Full outside off, Root bends his back knee and drives it crisply but finds the man at covers.
Full toss on middle, eased down to long on for a one.
Tossed up on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Shortish delivery, angling in, Root pulls it over square leg and gets a run. 10 runs off the over!
Angling into Hales, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched on a length outside off, Hales plays with loose hands towards covers. Is lucky that the ball doesn't carry to the fielder there.
Length delivery outside off, defended on the off side.

FOUR! In the air... but in no man's land! Banged in short by Morris, takes Hales by surprise. He still goes through with his hook, gets a top edge and the ball lands safely in the fine leg region and crosses the fence on one bounce. Another boundary for Hales!

FOUR! Just a push! Fuller length outside off, Hales first go a touch back and then drives it to perfection. Beats mid off and the ball races to the fence. The English opener is looking very solid out there!
Full on middle, Hales leans ahead and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. Just a single from the over. Good start by the leggie!
Googly on the shorter side outside off, Alex reads it and punches it off the back foot to covers.
Tossed up outside off, driven crisply but straight to covers.
Leg spinner around off, Hales opens the face of the bat and places it in the cover-point region.
Flatter delivery outside off, keeps a touch low, cut straight to covers.
Served on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Imran Tahir comes into the attack now.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Now, maximum 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner ring till the 40th over.
Fullish delivery around off, Root pushes it to covers.

On a length and it comes in appreciably from outside off, Root walks across a touch and closes his bat face early as he looks to clip it. Gets a slight leading edge that falls safely in the cover region.
Good length delivery around off, Root camps back and punches it nicely to covers.
Fullish delivery around off, Joe lunges forward and strokes it to mid off.
Beaten! Fullish delivery well outside off, Root reaches out to it and looks to carve it square of the wicket but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
On a good length outside off, Root stays back and lets it go.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Hales times his clip nicely through mid-wicket. Parnell in the deep runs to his left and puts in a slide to keep the ball in play. Two runs taken.
Fullish and straight again, defended nicely this time.
Fullish delivery on off, pushed confidently off the front foot to mid on.
Fails to capitalize on the Free Hit! Hales moves across his crease and looks to unsettle Rabada. He follows him with a low full toss and Alex fails to put it away.
Free Hit coming up! Third one of the innings. The field can change as the batsmen crossed. So, third man comes up.
No ball! Fullish and going down leg this time, Root nudges it through square leg for a run. Rabada again oversteps. Third no ball for him.
On a length and tailing in sharply, clipped to square leg for a single this time.
Appreciable inward movement! On a length and tailing in sharply, Hales is stuck on the crease and looks to keep it out. Misses to get rapped on the thigh pad.
Fullish delivery and shaping in, driven to mid off.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
50-run stand between Root and Hales!
Fullish and angling in, Alex drives it crisply towards mid on. Parnell dives to his left and keeps it down to a single.
FOUR! Shot! On a length outside off, Hales drives it with an open face through cover-point. Has timed that well and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Back of a length outside off, cut to third man for a run.
Yorker on off, Root digs it out towards the slip region.
Chris Morris comes into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, Root guides it towards third man for a run. Thinks about the second but then decides against it.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, driven to mid on.
Brilliant yorker on off, Root stays leg side of the ball and jams it out to covers.
Free Hit coming your way!
No ball! On a good length on off, Root stays back and defends it nicely to the off side. Rabada overstepped on that occasion.
On a length and angling in sharply, Root looks to tuck but is hit on the pads.
Well bowled! Rabada bangs in short just outside off, Root drops his wrists to let it through.
FOUR! Well played! Good length delivery outside off, Root guides it nicely past second slip who dives to his right but fails to stop it. Another well-earned boundary.
FOUR! Shot! Fullish delivery on middle, Hales flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.

Good fielding, AB de Villiers! Fuller length ball outside off, Root takes a couple of steps down the track and drives it towards de Villiers. He moves swiftly to his right from mid off and dives to stop it. The batsmen complete the run safely in the end.
On a fuller length this time and angling away from Hales. He pushes at it but gets an outside edge to third man. A run taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Wristwork at its best! Fuller length ball slanting across Hales. He takes it from outside off and clips it through mid-wicket for an elegant boundary.
Hales stays back to the length delivery in line of the stumps and gets behind it solidly.
Good game awareness! Fullish delivery outside off, Hales pushes it with soft hands to wide mid off and calls immediately. His partner responds and they complete the run with ease. 11 from that over.
Straighter this time, Hales tucked to mid-wicket.
Full delivery just outside off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Takes full toll of the Free Hit! Full toss and room on offer, Hales frees his arms and carves it through point for another boundary.
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! On a length and angling into Hales. He flicks it to mid-wicket. Rabada overstepped on that occasion.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a single.

FOUR! Good timing! Good length delivery outside off, Root waits for it and pushes it with an angled bat towards point. Duminy dives full length to his right but fails to stop it. Well played and he gets the desired result!
Fullish delivery around off, defended solidly off the front foot. Parnell slipped a touch in his followthrough but no harm done.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish in line of the stumps, Hales pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge towards point.
Fullish and on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Straying on the pads, clipped in front of square on the leg side for a run.
In the air.. but safe! On a length outside off, Root drives it uppishly towards extra cover. The fielder dives to his right but the ball falls short of him and goes through. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fullish and straying on the pads, Hales flicks it with good timing through front of square on the leg side and earns himself a boundary.

That was a jaffa! On a length outside off, shapes in sharply. Hales looks to play a drive down the ground but he is not in a good position to play it. Ends up missing it and the ball whizzes over his stumps. De Kock dives full length to his left but can't stop it. Four byes signaled by the umpire!
Back of a length delivery just outside off, Hales knows where his off stump is and makes a good leave.
Fuller length ball on off, Hales drives it towards Rabada who makes a partial stop in his followthrough and deflects it to his left. The batsmen look for a single but decide against it.
Fullish and too straight on this occasion, Hales clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of a length outside off, Root rises on his toes and dabs it behind point for a single.
A touch short outside off, Hales goes for a cut but only manages to connect thin air. A wicket and three runs from that over.
Similar length delivery around off, stroked to mid off.
Great work, Miller! Fuller length ball outside off, Hales drives it sweetly towards extra cover. Miller dives to his right to make an excellent stop. Saves a certain boundary for his side.

Good way to get off the mark! Fullish delivery around off, Root leans into it and strokes it through covers. Good timing on that one and de Villiers from wide mid off has to hare after that. Slides near the fence and saves a run for his side.
Joe Root strides out to bat.

OUT! Just the start South Africa wanted! On a fuller length and slanting across Roy. He goes for an expansive drive but makes the mistake of playing away from his body. Ends up getting a thick outside edge and de Kock behind the stumps moves a touch to his right and takes a straightforward catch. Poor shot and Roy pays the price for it. His lean patch with the bat continues.
Fullish delivery around off, pushed confidently off the front foot to mid off.
Wayne Parnell to bowl from the other end with the other new ball. Two slips in place for him.
Similar length delivery outside off, Roy goes for the drive but gets an outside edge past the diving gully fielder. A run taken. A tidy first over from Rabada.
Fuller length ball outside off, Roy walks down the track and drives it crisply to mid off.
Full length delivery outside off, Hales is lured into it and pushes at it with hard hands. Ends up getting a thick outside edge to third man for a run.
On a length outside off, Hales points his bat skywards and allows it through.

Leg bye! Full length delivery and shaping in this time, Jason looks to flick it through square leg but misses. The ball brushes his pads and the ball rolls to the left side of the keeper. A leg bye taken.
Starts off with a fullish delivery outside off, nice away movement on that. Roy plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.

So after observing a minute of silence, the Proteas have made their way out in the middle and are currently in a huddle. Jason Roy and Alex Hales to open the batting for England. Kagiso Rabada to start the proceedings with the first new ball. Three slips in place. Here we go...
There would be a minute's silence at the start of the match and players of both the teams will wear a black armband in memory of those who lost their lives in the Manchester attack.
South Africa XI - Hashim Amla, Quinton de Kock(WK), Faf du Plessis, AB de Villiers(C), JP Duminy, David Miller, Chris Morris, Wayne Parnell, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Imran Tahir.
England XI - Alex Hales, Jason Roy, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(C), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler(WK), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Liam Plunkett, Mark Wood.
TOSS - South Africa win the toss and opt to field.

The hosts on the other hand have come into their own after a dismal performance in the 2015 World Cup. They are on a 6-match winning streak but they would surely be tested against the numero uno side. It is bright and sunny at the moment and we hope it will remain the same throughout the day. Expect a thrilling contest!

Hello and a warm welcome to the first of the 3-match ODI series between England and South Africa at Headingley, Leeds. This series is going to be a good preparation for both the teams going into the Champions Trophy. The Proteas are currently the first ranked team in ODIs and AB de Villiers would expect his team to live upto that.
